text:
alex: quick sync 1: pen test retest next week. need final decisions: RBAC freeze window, KMS access pattern, audit snapshot. who owns liaison with assessor?

maria: I can own assessor liaison and the readroom bundle.

alex: thanks. window: Mon 2024-07-01 08:00 UTC for 48h. RBAC changes must be staged + explicit rollback steps.

jordan: RBAC plan: create role `assessor/temp-access` with 2h sessions, no write to prod-secrets, explicit deny on kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion. PR ready.

samir: KMS constraints: we must not hand over raw key access. proposing KMS proxy that enforces allow-list operations and logs every Decrypt/Encrypt call. ops-liaison, can infra host proxy for the window?

ops-liaison: yes. we'll create ephemeral key `ephemeral-pt-key`, proxy with short-lived tokens. presigned S3 for readroom will be IP-restricted. example IAM condition will include `aws:SourceIp` and `aws:CurrentTime`.

maria: audit snapshot: export authz.log (allow/deny), kms.audit, and infra.audit for full 24h starting at 08:00 UTC. store zip in readroom. retention: snapshot only for assessor review, then rotate out after SLA.

jordan: add smoke tests: 1) staging PR to enable proxy 2) smoke decrypt with known ciphertext 3) verify kms.audit shows requestId. schedule dry run Fri 2024-06-28 16:00 UTC.

samir: note: add an offline-proof artifact link (signed log excerpt) to the evidence bundle so post-retest verification doesn't rely on live access.

sec-bot: Action: create ticket SE-PT-9721 with attachments (RBAC PR link, KMS policy, readroom link, rollback playbook). Due: 2024-06-26 EOD.

ops-liaison: will produce ephemeral role mapping and presigned link. will include ASN/IP restriction and expiry aligned to window.

maria: liaison checklist Im tracking: create role, merge RBAC PR, enable proxy, run staging smoke, export logs, package readroom, coordinate retest slot. I'll paste PR links and S3 URL here.

jordan: PR: https://git.redwood/ops/infra/pulls/498 includes role and trust policy. please review deny rules for write operations.

samir: small ask: can we ensure proxy emits structured JSON logs with fields `requestId`, `principal`, `action`, `resource`? that'll simplify evidence ingestion.

ops-liaison: yes, proxy will log JSON. smoke test output (staging): `2024-06-28T16:00:12Z INFO kms-proxy test decrypt requestId=tx-77ae status=200 principal=assessor/temp-access resource=ephemeral-pt-key`

maria: perfect. will include that line in the readroom and add the zipped audit snapshot.

alex: one more gating Q: restrict assessor to CIDR list?

ops-liaison: yes, presigned link and ephemeral role will be scoped to their ASN IPs.

maria: publishing timeline: dry run complete Friday, final artifacts by Saturday AM, retest coordination Monday 07:50 UTC pre-window sync.

jordan: I'm good. leaving review comments on PR for an explicit Deny on kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion.

samir: once PR merged, ops-liaison triggers smoke test and posts logs here.

ops-liaison: SE-PT-9721 created and assigned. will attach S3 readroom when ready.

alex: thanks team. closing coordination thread. :white_check_mark:
